messages:
Eli (Sales): quick sync: Hyperlyft POC. Requests: p99 chat <=300ms 9-6, burst to 1.1k qps for product launches, nightly embed 40k items in 4h. Also submitted security checklist. can we outline reserved vs burst + billing?

Rosa (Solutions): recommend hybrid: reserve baseline for business hours, pre-purchased burst credits for spikes, and nightly embeddings on spot workers. Need KMS + SIEM details from ops.

Vik (Runtime): traffic summary: steady 280 qps, spikes to 1.1k for 10-25m. Proposal:
- model: rwd-3b-q8 low-latency
- reserve: 3 x A40-equivalents baseline
- burst pool: 2 prewarmed GPUs, auto-add up to 4 if credits available
- fallback: rwd-1.3b-q4 under exhausted-burst policy

Sam (Ops): billing: reserved counts toward commit. burst usage consumes credits; we can include monthly burst credit bucket. preheat while reserved is not billed extra; ad-hoc preheat on demand billed against burst unless scheduled 48h.

Eli (Sales): client worried about surprise charges during marketing events. can we offer a buffer of emergency burst credits with rate cap?

Sam (Ops): yes — can include emergency buffer (non-refundable) and per-minute rate cap for metered overflow. will need sign-off from commercial.

Vik (Runtime): autoscale rules (sketch): scale-up when p99 > 250ms for 30s OR queue depth > 80; cooldown 5m; max scale 6x baseline. add automatic model-fallback route with header X-Model-Fallback for auditing.

Rosa (Solutions): security: we support customer-managed KMS in Dedicated, and log-forwarding to their SIEM. LegalBot: any red flags on contract terms for preheat/credits?

LegalBot: flag: define p99 calculation window (rolling 5m) and excluded events (DDoS, external network outage). will draft simple SLA addendum.

MetricsBot: note: we'll provide per-route latency dashboards and token-cost telemetry during POC.

Eli (Sales): next steps: (1) Sam draft billing appendix with emergency credits + rate cap, (2) Vik run fallback eval on 150 sample prompts, (3) Rosa prepare security appendix, (4) LegalBot draft SLA addendum. i'll send plan to Hyperlyft and schedule a preheat rehearsal. resolving until client responds. :white_check_mark:
